title: Clicking a desktop only moves the primary display's desktop when desktops are configured to switch independently per screen
line: With desktops switching independently per screen, clicking a desktop in the Pager now switches every screen to it, not only the screen the Pager is on.
explanation: With per-screen virtual desktops, each Pager cell shows a desktop across all screens, but clicking it asked KWin to switch only the Pager's own screen. The other screens stayed on their old desktop while the Pager highlighted the whole cell. Now, when the Pager shows all screens, a click (or wheel step) switches every screen to that desktop; with 'Show only the current screen' it still switches just its own screen.

commits.message:
applets/pager: switch all screens when the pager shows all screens

With per-screen virtual desktops, clicking a desktop only switched the
screen the pager is on, although each cell shows every screen. When the
pager shows all screens, switch every screen to the clicked desktop.
